sourceMaterials.title: Tunde Adebayo — curriculum vitae
sourceMaterials.content: Tunde Adebayo. BEng Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Covenant University, 2019–2023. Machine-learning engineer at GridSense Africa, January 2024–present. Built load-forecasting pipelines and anomaly-detection prototypes for distribution networks. Final-year project on edge inference for low-cost power-quality sensors. Skills: Python, PyTorch, embedded C, signal processing and MLOps. Manuscript ‘Self-supervised event detection for weak distribution grids’ was submitted to IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid on 4 May 2026; no decision has been received.

sourceMaterials.title: Covenant University transcript
sourceMaterials.content: Bachelor of Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering. Cumulative GPA 3.72/4.00. Degree requirements completed 28 July 2023; degree awarded 18 August 2023; ceremony 29 September 2023. Courses include Signals and Systems A, Probability and Statistics A, Linear Algebra B+, Data Structures B+, Control Systems A and Digital Signal Processing A. No course titled Machine Learning appears on the transcript.

sourceMaterials.title: Employment record
sourceMaterials.content: GridSense Africa, machine-learning engineer, 8 January 2024–present. National service and independent study, 1 October–20 December 2023. Summer embedded-systems intern, Ardent Controls, June–August 2022. Current and permanent residence: Lagos, Nigeria. Nigerian citizen.

sourceMaterials.title: Referee list
sourceMaterials.content: Dr Mercy Olanrewaju supervised the final-year project and can discuss academic research. Chidi Nwosu is Tunde’s current engineering manager and can discuss production ML work. Both have agreed to be considered; no request has yet been sent for this application.

sourceMaterials.title: Career goals
sourceMaterials.content: My goal is an AI or machine-learning master’s that accepts a strong engineering background and can prepare me for applied research. I can self-fund tuition up to £18,000 but would need support above that amount. I have no disciplinary history.
